summary: The recorded base already accepts the original two-text function_call_output array, so the historical 400 was not reproducible at that revision; it does concatenate the parts without a boundary. The base independently reproduced all three review counterexamples by dropping image/file-only outputs and conflating mixed parts. Exact candidate 985180a preserves those schema-valid parts as newline-delimited text/compact JSON, passes its regression suite, and passes independent request-schema plus real input-construction probes. This is a production correction with regression coverage, not test-only hardening.

tests.what_was_measured: ResponsesRequest schema validation and OpenAIServingResponses._construct_input_messages on the original payload plus independent image-only, file-id, file-data, mixed, embedded-newline, and empty-array cases. The original payload was accepted rather than producing the historical 400, while all three specified lossy-normalization counterexamples reproduced. Raw output: evidence/base_probe.txt.

The same schema-valid cases through direct normalization and actual request-message construction. Candidate output retained text boundaries and serialized every image/file part without loss. Raw output: evidence/candidate_probe.txt.
Candidate-focused normalization regression: 8 passed. Raw output: evidence/candidate_focused_tests.txt.
Complete Responses serving unit file: 39 passed and 2 subtests passed. Raw output: evidence/candidate_full_tests.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: The host exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, but this deterministic Python request-normalization review did not execute GPU kernels.

native_rebuild_evidence: The base-to-candidate production diff changes only python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_responses.py; no native source or extension changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and the reported deepseekv4/DSPARK serving configuration were unavailable, so architecture-specific generation was not run.
No model-backed HTTP server was started; validation covered request schema parsing and the real internal construction path before tokenization/generation.

The exact historical 400 cannot be demonstrated on the recorded base because that base already includes array acceptance; the observed remaining base defects are lossy content conversion and missing part boundaries.
